mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite high INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of HOUST and RSAFS, where both increase by more than 5% YoY, signals robust demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in robust demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in FEDFUNDS by more than 0.5% in 2 months signals a monetary policy shift, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite rapid FEDFUNDS increase.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of UNRATE below 6% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 0.5% MoM signals a labor market imbalance, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite labor market imbalance.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high GDPC1 growth rate (> 3% YoY) in conjunction with low UNRATE (< 5%) signals a demand-driven economic boom, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in boom periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
